name: paradigm
description: Unified developer tools ecosystem - Purpose, Portal, and Premise

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:gnomon && npm run build:packages && npm run build:cli
scripts.build:core: npm run build --workspace=@a-company/paradigm-logger && npm run build --workspace=@a-company/university-core && npm run build --workspace=@a-company/purpose-core && npm run build --workspace=@a-company/portal-core && npm run build --workspace=@a-company/probe-core
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@a-company/portal-sdk && npm run build --workspace=@a-company/portal-manager && npm run build --workspace=@a-company/portal-viewer && npm run build --workspace=@a-company/premise-core && npm run build --workspace=@a-company/warpline && npm run build --workspace=@a-company/sentinel && npm run build --workspace=@a-company/paradigm-runtime && npm run build --workspace=@a-company/paradigm-mcp
scripts.build:gnomon: npm run build --workspace=@a-company/gnomon-contracts && npm run build --workspace=@a-company/gnomon-mod-sdk && npm run build --workspace=@a-company/gnomon-voice && npm run build --workspace=@a-company/gnomon-local && npm run build --workspace=@a-company/gnomon
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/paradigm-mcp && tsc --noEmit -p packages/paradigm && tsc --noEmit -p packages/sentinel && tsc --noEmit -p packages/gnomon
scripts.release: node scripts/release.mjs --check && npm run build && node scripts/release.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:cli && npm run test:warpline && npm run test:gnomon
scripts.test:warpline: npm run build --workspace=@a-company/warpline && npm run test --workspace=@a-company/warpline
scripts.test:gnomon: npm run build:gnomon && npm run test --workspace=@a-company/gnomon-contracts && npm run test --workspace=@a-company/gnomon-mod-sdk && npm run test --workspace=@a-company/gnomon-local && npm run test --workspace=@a-company/gnomon-gui && npm run test --workspace=@a-company/gnomon

author: ascend42
